home.about_description: HomenaJesus.com is a digital songbook for Church music ministries. It helps ministry directors prepare their repertoire, organize songs, and have everything ready to accompany Holy Mass and other celebrations. Content stays available online and can be updated whenever the ministry needs it.
home.overview_description: Use it to prepare and manage songs, songbooks, and repertoires for your celebrations.
features: Chords are always perfectly aligned, on any screen or font size.
Live mode, with autoscroll and quick font size adjustment.
Your repertoire saved online and available to your whole team.
You can transpose songs according to musical rules, not just mathematical shifting.
home.platform_title: Do you also play other musical genres?
home.platform_description: HomenaJesus focuses on Christian music and the needs of Church ministries. For other musical genres, you can also use ChordProject.com.

songbook_page.option_use_official: Explore public songbooks organized by seasons, themes, or celebrations.
